input.business_intent: which stores and product categories are driving the highest sales, and how does sales performance vary by region, city and customer segment

args.sql_query:
-- Query 1: Store-level sales performance
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        fs.store_id,
        ds.store_name,
        ds.region,
        ds.city,
        ds.state,
        fs.product_id,
        dp.category,
        dp.standard_price,
        fs.quantity,
        fs.customer_segment,
        fs.return_amount,
        CAST(fs.quantity AS DOUBLE) * dp.standard_price AS gross_revenue
    FROM fact_sales fs
    LEFT JOIN dim_store ds ON fs.store_id = ds.store_id
    LEFT JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_id = dp.product_id
    WHERE fs.quantity > 0
)
SELECT
    store_id,
    store_name,
    region,
    city,
    state,
    COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(gross_revenue), 2) AS total_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(gross_revenue), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_transaction
FROM base
GROUP BY store_id, store_name, region, city, state
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

-- Query 2: Category-level sales performance
SELECT
    dp.category,
    COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(CAST(fs.quantity AS DOUBLE)) AS total_units_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(CAST(fs.quantity AS DOUBLE) * dp.standard_price), 2) AS total_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(dp.standard_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price
FROM fact_sales fs
LEFT JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE fs.quantity > 0
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

-- Query 3: Regional sales performance
SELECT
    ds.region,
    COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(CAST(fs.quantity AS DOUBLE)) AS total_units_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(CAST(fs.quantity AS DOUBLE) * dp.standard_price), 2) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fs.store_id) AS store_count
FROM fact_sales fs
LEFT JOIN dim_store ds ON fs.store_id = ds.store_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE fs.quantity > 0 AND ds.region IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ds.region
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

-- Query 4: Customer Segment performance
SELECT
    CASE 
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fs.customer_segment)) IN ('prem','premium') THEN 'Premium'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fs.customer_segment)) = 'loyal' THEN 'Loyal'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fs.customer_segment)) = 'new' THEN 'New'
        ELSE fs.customer_segment
    END AS customer_segment_clean,
    COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(CAST(fs.quantity AS DOUBLE)) AS total_units_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(CAST(fs.quantity AS DOUBLE) * dp.standard_price), 2) AS total_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(fs.quantity AS DOUBLE) * dp.standard_price), 2) AS avg_basket_value
FROM fact_sales fs
LEFT JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE fs.quantity > 0
GROUP BY customer_segment_clean
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

-- Query 5: City-level sales performance
SELECT
    ds.city,
    ds.region,
    ds.state,
    COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(CAST(fs.quantity AS DOUBLE)) AS total_units_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(CAST(fs.quantity AS DOUBLE) * dp.standard_price), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM fact_sales fs
LEFT JOIN dim_store ds ON fs.store_id = ds.store_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE fs.quantity > 0 AND ds.city IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ds.city, ds.region, ds.state
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

-- Query 6: Top products by revenue
SELECT
    dp.product_id,
    dp.product_name,
    dp.category,
    dp.standard_price,
    COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(CAST(fs.quantity AS DOUBLE)) AS total_units_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(CAST(fs.quantity AS DOUBLE) * dp.standard_price), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM fact_sales fs
LEFT JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE fs.quantity > 0
GROUP BY dp.product_id, dp.product_name, dp.category, dp.standard_price
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Query 7: Region x Customer Segment cross-analysis
SELECT
    ds.region,
    CASE 
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fs.customer_segment)) IN ('prem','premium') THEN 'Premium'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fs.customer_segment)) = 'loyal' THEN 'Loyal'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fs.customer_segment)) IN ('std','standard') THEN 'Standard'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fs.customer_segment)) IN ('bgt','budget') THEN 'Budget'
        ELSE fs.customer_segment
    END AS segment,
    COUNT(*) AS transactions,
    ROUND(SUM(CAST(fs.quantity AS DOUBLE) * dp.standard_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM fact_sales fs
LEFT JOIN dim_store ds ON fs.store_id = ds.store_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE fs.quantity > 0 AND ds.region IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ds.region, segment
ORDER BY ds.region, revenue DESC

-- Query 8: Return rate and net sales summary by store
SELECT
    ds.store_name,
    ds.region,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fs.quantity > 0 THEN CAST(fs.quantity AS DOUBLE) * dp.standard_price ELSE 0 END), 2) AS gross_revenue,
    ROUND(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN fs.quantity < 0 THEN fs.return_amount ELSE 0 END)), 2) AS total_returns,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fs.quantity > 0 THEN CAST(fs.quantity AS DOUBLE) * dp.standard_price ELSE 0 END) 
          + SUM(CASE WHEN fs.quantity < 0 THEN fs.return_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM fact_sales fs
LEFT JOIN dim_store ds ON fs.store_id = ds.store_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE ds.store_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ds.store_name, ds.region
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
